summary: Join our Gender and Financial Inclusion Training Course to explore strategies for empowering women in finance. Make a difference in your community!
lede: Gender and financial inclusion examines how financial systems can better serve women and marginalized communities facing barriers to formal finance. For professionals in finance, policy, and social development, the training supports practical work to identify access barriers, design gender-responsive financial products, and use gender-disaggregated data to assess inclusion outcomes.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals and institutions working at the intersection of finance, inclusion, and gender equality, including:
audience: Policymakers and regulatory officers in ministries
Corporate leaders in CSR, ESG, and inclusive
modules: Identifying Barriers to Women’s Financial Access
Gender Lens Investing and Impact Finance
